title: WOS Notice Requirement
description: Declared notice observation, evidence scope and clock anchor. Declaration validity does not establish installed provider capability or authenticate historical evidence. Governance S3.2 and S3.5.

observation.description: Exact selected observation. Sending, provider delivery, observed opening and deliberate acknowledgment do not substitute for one another. Opening does not prove reading.

scope.description: Scope retained in derived clock and effect evidence. Fixture qualification cannot satisfy production scope.

anchor.description: Ordinary informational status uses none. Consequence-bearing use requires the original immutable qualified observation. Period and calendar rules remain in their existing policy owner.
